newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLL-FIM 06 BOND YIELD SEEN AT 6.50 PCT BY JUNE 98.
newsitem.headline: POLL-FIM 06 BOND YIELD SEEN AT 6.50 PCT BY JUNE 98.

text.p: The Finnish 7.25-percent 2006
benchmark bond yield was seen trading at around 6.50 percent by
June next year, according to a Reuters poll.
The majority of the 23 dealers, economists and analysts at
banks and corporate treasuries polled forecast the 2006 bond
yield at levels around 6.50 percent one year from now -- while
two corporate treasuries and one bank expected the yield to
trade at 6.00 percent.
Two respondents saw scope for the yield to jump to 7.00
percent by June 1998.
By September this year, the majority of respondents expected
the 2006 bond yield to trade around 6.25 percent, while three
forecast the yield at 6.00 percent or below.
Three participants saw the yield rising to 6.50 percent or
above.
The poll was conducted by telephone on May 22-23 -- before
the first round of the French general election on Sunday -- and
the forecasts were collected on an anonymous basis.
Finnish bond yields rose on Monday in line with other
European markets. At 1345/1045 GMT, the 2006 bond yield was at
6.25 percent, up from 6.18 percent last Friday.
2006 BOND YIELD BY JUNE 1998:
Median 6.50 percent
Average 6.52 percent
Range 6.00-7.00 percent
2006 BOND YIELD BY SEPTEMBER:
Median 6.25 percent
Average 6.26 percent
Range 5.75-6.60 percent
